snippet.title: Forge of the Fae - Official Trailer | Mundo Gamer Showcase 2026 - Edition 01
snippet.description:
What secrets lie within a world shaped by magic and choices?

Forge of the Fae is a pixel art RPG inspired by Celtic folklore, where your decisions shape the story and your power grows through a unique crystal-based system.

Explore a world full of mystery, danger, and magic as you uncover the truth behind a series of disappearances.

🛒 Add it to your Steam wishlist
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2160070/Forge_of_the_Fae/

✨ About the Game

🌍 A Rich Fantasy World
• Explore a world inspired by Celtic mythology
• Uncover mysteries tied to disappearances and conflict

🧠 Meaningful Choices
• Your decisions impact the story and its outcome
• Shape your journey through alliances and actions

🔮 ARC Crystal System
• Customize your abilities using crystal-based magic
• Build your own combat style with flexible mechanics

⚔️ Dynamic Turn-Based Combat
• Fast-paced battles inspired by classic JRPGs
• Combine abilities and exploit enemy weaknesses

🔥 Deep Combat Systems
• Create combos and powerful synergies
• Use special techniques without consuming turns

🎨 Retro Meets Modern
• Beautiful pixel art with modern gameplay design
• A blend of nostalgia and innovation
